{{Top}}
[[File:Imperial_Admiral.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Admiral]]
{{Quote|An admiral must go down with his ship.|Admiral [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]]|<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>}}
The title of '''admiral''' was a senior command [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] in many [[Navy/Legends|navies]] and [[Fleet/Legends|starfleets]]. Admirals, also known generally as '''flag officers''', were typically responsible for a high level military command at [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] or [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] level, and/or for administrative and political duties relating to naval operations.

==Basic terminology==
[[File:AdmiralKilian-SWE.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]], an Admiral of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fleet during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
{{Quote|A wise admiral is never surprised by a scenario, for he has run them all in his head during sleepless nights.|Admiral Gial Ackbar|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
Most navies made use of various grades of admiral, with the basic hierarchy of [[Rear Admiral/Legends|Rear Admiral]], [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] and full admiral seemingly almost universal. Below rear-admiral, the position of commodore was often regarded as a junior flag rank, and at least one instance of a [[Brevet]] Admiral is known. Some navies also had superior flag ranks above full Admiral, such as the [[Admiral of the Fleet/Legends|Admiral of the Fleet]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Usage==

===Galactic Republic===
A number of Admirals were known to have served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the fortieth century BBY, during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]], but the use of the title seems to have been reasonably restricted: in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the main Republic fleet had been commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orley Vanicus]], and captains like [[Saul Karath]] continued to serve subsequently as [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] commanders.

Little is known about flag ranks in the subsequent millennia of Old Republic history, and during the Clone Wars, captains like [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and [[Sagoro Autem]] were once again found as squadron and fleet commanders. However, a few admirals were known to have held field commands, such as [[Arikakon Baraka]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who commanded the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class]] [[Nexu (starship)|''Nexu'']], and the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]], who commanded at [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]. Curiously, whereas Pellaeon and Autem commanded significant task forces of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], these admirals apparently had only their own [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] and attached surface units under their authority, but it may be significant that both Bleyd and Baraka seem to have had no [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] in their chain of command, and were thus the ultimate authority for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of their commands.

Other flag officers held high positions on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], a situation that perhaps predated the Clone Wars, and indeed may have continued from before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. An admiral named [[Jerjerrod (admiral)|Jerjerrod]] is recorded serving at [[Naval Command (Galactic Republic)|Naval Command]], while an Admiral [[Kiner]] is named as the Republic's last important counter-espionage expert before its security and spying networks were amalgamated into [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. [[Ronnan Tyla Vedij]] may likewise have reached flag rank under the Republic rather than the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

===Sith Empire===
This rank was in use in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Alliance and New Republic===
[[File:Admiral_Ackbar-AoR.jpg|thumb|right|240px|[[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], admiral of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]]]
Under the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], each battle line was commanded by a Line Admiral: the only two officers who can be said to have held a different level of flag rank are [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], styled "Admiral of the Fleet" as the Alliance's overall naval commander, and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Wirriz]], who is known to have held the rank of vice admiral. Wirriz's rank probably indicates the use of the standard three-tier structure of flag ranks within Alliance forces, but in the absence of further proof, other interpretations remain possible: for instance, the title of Vice Admiral might have been accorded to the naval second-in-command, with all further flag officers being line admirals.

Under the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the ranks of commodore, rear admiral and vice admiral are recorded explicitly, and it is likely that full admirals also existed, although the more ambiguous range of meaning of the simple term ''admiral'' means that conclusive evidence is lacking. Thus, while it is known that an admiral was graded 'C-1' and regarded as equivalent to a [[General/Legends|general]] in the chain of command, it may be that this definition in fact extended to all New Republic flag officers.

Strictly speaking, there is only actually evidence for a rank of "Vice Admiral (retired)", held by the veteran [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] commander [[Kursk Mal'ia]], after he stood down from active duty. This could have been an honorary appointment granted at the end of a career, and as with the Rebellion, it cannot ultimately be ruled out that all active-duty "admirals" in the New Republic were, in fact, basically rear admirals.

At the head of the New Republic fleet hierarchy, the style "Admiral of the Fleet" remained Ackbar's unique prerogative, reflecting his decades of service as [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]. Perhaps in respect of Ackbar's reputation, his successor [[Sien Sovv]] opted to use the title [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] instead, which was awarded to at least one other admiral serving alongside him during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Traest Kre'fey]].

===Imperial Navy===
[[File:AdmiralPiett-TCGBotF.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], an Admiral of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]]]
In the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], to cope with the immense expansion in the size of the fleet, a number of additional flag ranks were created within the [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Group]] hierarchy. A simple style of admiral denoted the lowest of these grades, indicating command of a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], and a rank not markedly higher than [[Senior Captain|Captain of the Line]]. Above this came a hierarchy of [[Systems admiral|Systems Admirals]] and [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admirals]] under the [[High Admiral]] of the Sector, usually a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. In some cases within the context of Imperial Admirals, the term "admiral" can also be used as a general term for various Admirals even if their actual rank was higher than the simple style. An admiral in the Imperial Navy commanded ten times as many forces as an admiral of the same rank did under the Galactic Republic.

The Empire also retained a normal hierarchy of rear admirals, vice admirals, and full admirals, but the exact relationship of these ranks to the Sector Group titles is unclear. What is known for sure is that [[Michael Unther]], having previously served as a fleet admiral or even a High Admiral, was subsequently promoted to rear admiral, normally the most junior substantive flag rank. It is possible that many Sector Group Admirals may have been little more than senior [[Captain/Legends|captains]], in a system perhaps connected with the unusual usage of the title of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] recorded in the Imperial Navy. Although most promotions to Admiral were treated as an honor, admirals who were promoted aboard and assigned to the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] were an exception, with many of its junior officers forming betting pools on its admiral's life expectancy due to the vessel's infamous reputation as the Imperial enforcer Darth Vader's flagship and its various admirals suffering from summary execution from failure as a result.<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], a rank of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] was created, ranking above all other Imperial flag officers, but shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was appointed [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]].

===Confederation===
In the [[Confederation]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the military forces were led by people holding the rank of Admiral. The most notable of these was [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who briefly commanded the Corellian forces until breaking with the government in the aftermath of their attempted assassination of [[Tenel Ka Djo]].

==Behind the scenes==
The usage of flag ranks in Star Wars is generally based on real-world conventions, but there are exceptions to this, most notably in the Imperial [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Group]] hierarchy discussed above.

Also, the lack of categorical references to full Admirals in the navies of the Rebel Alliance and New Republic cannot be countermanded by appeal to real-world standards: as the evolution of [[Wikipedia:Admiral (United States)|flag ranks in the United States Navy]] shows, scenarios are possible in which only part of the usual hierarchy of Admirals' ranks is used.
